authorization_interpretation: The user's instruction '冻结' authorizes freezing this contract only. It does not authorize simulated-Test inference, real-XRD access, retraining, checkpoint substitution, or any other execution.
scientific_question: On the completely held-out parent-structure Test split, does the already selected JS consistency method with frozen lambda_js=60 retain a positive paired robustness effect over Dynamic ERM under the frozen PXRD measurement profiles, without an unacceptable in-range performance loss?

historical_contract_resolution.issue: configs/evaluation.v9.method_transfer.json contains an early placeholder requiring three formal checkpoint hashes. The completed V9 design now consists of five paired training seeds and ten independently selected Validation checkpoints.
historical_contract_resolution.resolution: The historical evaluation file is not rewritten. For this simulated-Test stage, this preregistration is authoritative and requires all ten Validation-selected checkpoints listed below.

checkpoint_rule.principle: Evaluate exactly the Validation-selected best checkpoint already recorded for each of the ten registered runs. Do not choose a later, earlier, averaged, ensembled, or Test-favored checkpoint.
checkpoint_rule.checkpoint_binary_policy: Before inference, a read-only preflight must locate each local checkpoint binary and record its SHA-256. If any checkpoint is missing or its epoch/global step does not match this contract, stop. Retraining or substitution requires a new explicit scientific decision and cannot occur under this contract.

simulated_test_panel.manifest_rule: Generate all three deterministic manifests and freeze their SHA-256 values during read-only preflight before loading any checkpoint or computing any prediction. Manifest generation may inspect split identifiers and simulation configuration, but must not run model inference or summarize labels by model output.

metrics_and_aggregation.primary_definition: For each checkpoint, compute Macro-F1 for each of the six single-factor OOD profiles under each of the three frozen evaluation seeds; average across the 18 panel values. Compute JS minus ERM within each matched training-seed pair, then report the mean paired delta across five pairs.
metrics_and_aggregation.evaluation_seed_handling: Evaluation seeds are deterministic measurement-panel repeats, not independent training replicates. Average them within each checkpoint before computing the five training-seed paired effects. Do not inflate n by treating evaluation seeds, profiles, or structures as independent training runs.

interpretation_rule.supportive: mean paired primary OOD delta > 0, paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, and mean paired in-range delta >= -0.01
interpretation_rule.directionally_supportive: mean paired primary OOD delta > 0 but its paired-bootstrap interval includes 0, while mean paired in-range delta >= -0.01
interpretation_rule.not_supported_on_test: mean paired primary OOD delta <= 0 or mean paired in-range delta < -0.01
interpretation_rule.selection_consequence: No category permits retuning lambda, changing the selected method, excluding seeds, choosing alternative checkpoints, or rerunning with a modified Test panel. The Test result is confirmatory evidence and must be reported as observed.

execution_and_outputs.resume_after_interruption: Resume only incomplete checkpoint-panel jobs whose inputs and hashes match the frozen preflight. Never recompute completed jobs with changed code or manifests.
